style_notes: Clean minimal aesthetic, soft gradients, calm confident motion, subtle turquoise/cyan accents, real-shot texture fidelity, high-end commercial tone, emotional undertone 'Make it yours'.

shots.name: MIWO INTRO AURA
frames: Frame 1: Tabletop visible at bottom, product just entering frame from right-edge, background softly out of focus.
Frame 2: Camera moves slightly inward; product becomes more visible.
Frame 3: Product front face now in full view; lighting highlights front surface softly.
Frame 4: Subtle cyan fill light casts gentle accent on right side of product.
Frame 5: Slight reflection appears along the table surface beneath the product.
Frame 6: Product fully central; camera continues dolly-in.
Frame 7: Edge of product catches key light, small specular highlight appears.
Frame 8: Background blur deepens; product remains sharp.
Frame 9: Slight shadow beneath product shifts gently as camera moves.
Frame 10: Product front face remains in focus; lighting consistent.
Frame 11: Cyan accent becomes more noticeable on right side.
Frame 12: Camera continues dolly to mid-position; table surface texture subtly visible.
Frame 13: Minor shift in angle reveals thin side of product.
Frame 14: Lighting remains soft; no harsh shadows.
Frame 15: Product color fidelity is perfect — accurate to the reference.
Frame 16: Reflection beneath product subtly changes with camera motion.
Frame 17: Camera close enough that product fills ~60% of frame.
Frame 18: Specular highlight on edge pulses gently as camera moves.
Frame 19: Cyan accent remains consistent.
Frame 20: Slight drift of background blur; product remains pinned.
Frame 21: Product front face fully centered, minimal camera motion.
Frame 22: Table surface shadow reshapes slightly.
Frame 23: Camera dolly slows down, nearing stop.
Frame 24: End of shot: product perfectly framed, soft light wrap, background out of focus.

lighting.rim: cyan LED narrow beam behind right rear

shots.name: ARTISTIC SIDE ARC
frames: Frame 1: Camera begins on left side of product, table and background visible.
Frame 2: Start of arc movement: product still front-facing but slight side visible.
Frame 3: Product turned ~10° as camera moves.
Frame 4: Backlight engages subtly—cyan rim starts to show on far edge.
Frame 5: Product turned ~20°; lighting accentuates contour.
Frame 6: Reflection of table surface shifts.
Frame 7: Product turned ~30°; camera moving smoothly.
Frame 8: Depth of field shows edge spring into view.
Frame 9: Cyan accent stronger on the far side.
Frame 10: Product turned ~40°; lighting consistent.
Frame 11: Texture of side visible.
Frame 12: Arc continues; product ~50° turned.
Frame 13: Specular highlight on side rim.
Frame 14: Reflection shift on table.
Frame 15: Product ~60° turned; front face partly visible.
Frame 16: Shadow beneath product softens.
Frame 17: Cyan accent gently pulses with movement.
Frame 18: Arc almost complete; product ~70° turned.
Frame 19: Final side profile nearly in view.
Frame 20: Camera movement slows.
Frame 21: Product ~80° turned; nearly full side view.
Frame 22: Arc ends; camera stabilizes.
Frame 23: Product remains in frame center, slight motion.
Frame 24: End of shot: full side profile, lighting balanced, background soft.

lighting.rim: cyan LED narrow beam behind right rear

shots.name: MACRO TEXTURE EMOTION
frames: Frame 1: Macro lens, product surface in extreme close-up: fine material texture.
Frame 2: Camera moves micro-forward (~1 mm) toward surface.
Frame 3: Specular light small highlight appears on texture.
Frame 4: Cyan accent faint on edge of texture.
Frame 5: Material grain becomes sharper.
Frame 6: Slight micro shift of angle reveals more highlight.
Frame 7: Texture pattern fully resolved.
Frame 8: Reflection of soft box edges glimpsed.
Frame 9: Camera continues micro-motion: tiny forward.
Frame 10: Highlight subtly shifts right.
Frame 11: Shadow from texture depth becomes visible.
Frame 12: Cyan fill light touches bottom-right edge.
Frame 13: Micro movement upward ~0.5 mm.
Frame 14: Specular highlight moves accordingly.
Frame 15: Texture depth emphasized.
Frame 16: Camera motion slows.
Frame 17: Negative space of the texture around product edge becomes visible.
Frame 18: Lighting remains constant, no flicker.
Frame 19: Tiny shift left ~0.5 mm.
Frame 20: Highlight softens.
Frame 21: Camera almost static now.
Frame 22: Depth of field minimal; only texture in focus.
Frame 23: End of shot imminent.
Frame 24: Final frame: surface texture perfectly in view, balanced lighting.

lighting.rim: cyan LED narrow beam behind right rear (soft)

shots.name: SIGNATURE DESIGN HIGHLIGHT
frames: Frame 1: Product front face visible; camera at low angle beneath product mid-height.
Frame 2: Camera tilts upward by ~2°.
Frame 3: Product tilts back slightly (~5°) on tabletop.
Frame 4: Key light catches top edge of product.
Frame 5: Side rim visible; cyan accent backlight begins.
Frame 6: Camera tilt ~10°.
Frame 7: Shadow beneath product front shifts.
Frame 8: Reflection on tabletop faint but present.
Frame 9: Camera tilt ~15°.
Frame 10: Product top edge fully visible; logo comes into view.
Frame 11: Lighting remains steady; no flicker.
Frame 12: Camera tilt ~20°.
Frame 13: Cyan rim light stronger on upper edge.
Frame 14: Micro move left ~0.3°.
Frame 15: Table texture visible at bottom of frame.
Frame 16: Camera tilt ~22°.
Frame 17: Product lean ~7°.
Frame 18: Specular highlight on logo.
Frame 19: Micro motion slows.
Frame 20: Camera tilt ~24°.
Frame 21: Product front face now partially visible due to tilt.
Frame 22: End approach.
Frame 23: Movement reduces to near static.
Frame 24: Final frame: product tilt exposed, lighting perfect.

lighting.rim: cyan LED narrow beam behind right rear

shots.name: HERO TOP-DOWN REVEAL
frames: Frame 1: Camera directly above product showing table surrounding.
Frame 2: Slow zoom-out begins (~1% zoom).
Frame 3: Product centered; table edge begins to recede.
Frame 4: Cyan rim light on outer edge visible.
Frame 5: Background blur increased.
Frame 6: Zoom-out continues.
Frame 7: Reflection beneath product appears.
Frame 8: Table surface texture begins to soften.
Frame 9: Product occupies ~50% of frame.
Frame 10: Lighting consistent.
Frame 11: Zoom ~1.5%.
Frame 12: Cyan accent remains subtle.
Frame 13: Micro motion slows.
Frame 14: Camera almost static zoom.
Frame 15: Product still front-facing, flat.
Frame 16: Table boundary nearly out of frame.
Frame 17: Zoom ~2%.
Frame 18: Reflection slight shift.
Frame 19: Depth of field soft background.
Frame 20: Zoom ~2.5%.
Frame 21: Movement slows further.
Frame 22: Final stable shot.
Frame 23: Product fully revealed in hero framing.
Frame 24: End of shot: top-down view, product centered, lighting calm.

lighting.rim: cyan LED narrow beam behind right rear

shots.name: HUMAN CONNECTION HAND PICKUP
frames: Frame 1: Product on table, camera medium close.
Frame 2: Human hand enters frame from left edge.
Frame 3: Fingers gently touch product side.
Frame 4: Camera begins slight rack focus from product to hand.
Frame 5: Hand lifts product ~1 cm.
Frame 6: Lighting catches hand, product front visible.
Frame 7: Camera tilt ~1°.
Frame 8: Cyan accent on product outer edge.
Frame 9: Hand lifts further ~2 cm.
Frame 10: Table shadow shifts under product.
Frame 11: Reflection of hand visible on table.
Frame 12: Camera rack focus now sharper on hand and product together.
Frame 13: Hand rotates product slightly (~5°) while lifting.
Frame 14: Product front face visible, still correct color.
Frame 15: Micro motion of hand (~0.2°) begins.
Frame 16: Shadow beneath product soft.
Frame 17: Human hand completes lift.
Frame 18: Camera stabilizes.
Frame 19: Hand holds product; product centered.
Frame 20: Slight micro sway of hand (~0.2°).
Frame 21: End motion begins.
Frame 22: Hand still, product in hand, lighting consistent.
Frame 23: Camera holds.
Frame 24: Final frame: human connection established, product in hand, mood calm & confident.

lighting.rim: cyan LED narrow beam behind right rear

shots.name: ROTATION IN HAND
frames: Frame 1: Hand holding product front face toward camera.
Frame 2: Camera begins circular dolly around hand (~10° movement).
Frame 3: Product rotates ~5° within hand.
Frame 4: Cyan rim light catches far edge.
Frame 5: Camera completes ~15° of arc.
Frame 6: Product rotates ~10° more.
Frame 7: Reflection of thumb on product surface appears.
Frame 8: Camera side view ~30° from original.
Frame 9: Product rotates ~15°.
Frame 10: Depth-of-field keeps hand softly blurred, product sharp.
Frame 11: Cyan accent stronger.
Frame 12: Camera arc ~40°.
Frame 13: Product rotates ~20°.
Frame 14: Shadow beneath hand soft.
Frame 15: Camera arc slows.
Frame 16: Product rotation ~25°.
Frame 17: Lighting steady.
Frame 18: Camera arc ~45°.
Frame 19: Product rotation ~30°.
Frame 20: Camera begins end of arc.
Frame 21: Product almost back to front-facing.
Frame 22: Arm slightly visible holding product; lighting reveals material texture.
Frame 23: Micro motion ends.
Frame 24: Final frame: hand still holding product, product rotated to natural position, lighting calm.

lighting.rim: cyan LED narrow beam behind right rear
